limits: Numeric financial values are compared with explicit tolerances; primitive seed byte identity and SHA bindings establish provenance only.
All raw unsupported/inconclusive and naive-Gamma negative-control slots are retained; they are not hidden by conditioning readiness.
6SE evidence does not prove unbiasedness, universal accuracy or coverage; three streams do not establish statistical universality.
Full artifact has84 active cases in one synthetic weekday; expiry/holiday/DST source fixtures are earlier foundation tests and are not saved full-pilot observations.
Independent diagnostics permit a documented floating-price subtraction allowance; frozen teacher/reference precision/rare gates were not relaxed.
Pilot/API/serialization/CLI costs are nested scopes. API time is not added to CLI wall, and main/cold/fresh costs are not approved here.

minor_findings.detail: Known endpoint roundoff can transfer the endpoint between ATM/tail; full original denominator remains. No financial source changed.

Deep ITM/small-h second-price differences include price rounding amplified by h^-2. Independent60-digit targets agree within explicit rounding allowance; finite_h_bias storage includes numerical roundoff and cannot be read wholly as model bias.
